An eligible ChatGPT account and internet are required. No API-key setup or paid API fallback. This is a debug-signed testing build, distributed outside the Play Store.

FIRST USE

Install. Connect. Give it a task.

  1. 01

    Install the APK

    Open the downloaded APK on your phone. If Android requests it, permit this browser or file app to install this package. Keep Play Protect enabled.

  2. 02

    Continue with ChatGPT

    Sign in in your browser and allow Use your ChatGPT plan, where available. Return to the assistant and choose an available model. Existing plan limits apply.

  3. 03

    Type or dictate

    Try বাংলায় উত্তর দাও। Review dictated text before Run. Voice support depends on the phone’s speech service, which may use the internet.

Control selected apps and websites

You choose the access

Read the disclosure, enable the service in Android Accessibility settings, choose apps and tick the sharing checkbox for this task. For websites, choose your browser. Android may restrict sideloaded services; the app cannot grant itself access.

You approve each change

A floating panel shows proposed clicks, typing and scrolling. Approve allows one change. Move repositions the panel. Stop ends access. Return stops and reopens the assistant.

Screen text goes to OpenAI

Selected apps’ visible accessible text is shared during the task. Password and marked sensitive controls are excluded; other private text may be visible. Do not select confidential apps. No screen inspection occurs while idle.

A preview needs a local trial

Automated checks cover the interface, encrypted storage and approved actions in an Android 15 emulator. Live sign-in, voice and particular apps need testing on your phone. Some interfaces cannot be controlled. Later preview updates may require uninstalling this preview and signing in again.
